title: Low degree junta learning algorithm
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, define a random-example learning algorithm whose program at each requested accuracy is the low degree junta learning program with parameters $n$ and $k$. Its success probability is the probability that the output decision tree has relative Hamming distance at most the requested accuracy from the target; its uniform bounds on random-example calls and local work are, respectively, the junta tree call count times the node random-example bound and the junta tree call count times the node uniform-work bound, both evaluated with the per-call failure parameter derived from $k$ and $1/16$. Its membership-query bound is zero.
